method: User-authorized Patchright inspection of public service JavaScript. Synthetic programs only; no authentication or live challenge tokens imported into native transport.
implementation_policy: Original Rust work from observed contracts. Public bundle used only as research oracle; no source vendored. Unsupported host operations and interpreter errors never converted to success tokens.

synthetic_results.math_hypot: Scaled compensated sum; all arguments coerced; Infinity wins over NaN; no arguments and negative zero yield positive zero; large/small finite values verified

synthetic_results.opcode_29: Two strings compare UTF-16 code units; mixed primitive operands convert to numbers; NaN comparison is false
synthetic_results.function_bind: Prefix argument order and target receiver retained; rebinding cannot replace an existing receiver; Reflect.set partial application mutates aliased object
synthetic_results.window_input_handler_attributes: Initially null; object/function identity retained; primitive values clear to null; no events fabricated
synthetic_results.weak_set: Bounded arena identity membership, duplicate add, deletion, self reference, primitive rejection, empty own-key/JSON representation; Reflect.construct supports this explicit constructor and array iterable only
synthetic_results.number_predicates: Static Number predicates do not coerce; global isFinite/isNaN coerce supported primitives; Number() is zero and Number(undefined) is NaN
synthetic_results.math_sqrt: Negative zero preserved, negative inputs/missing arguments produce NaN, strings follow numeric conversion
